entities.name: Alfred Körte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Körte was a German classical philologist who was a native of Berlin. He was a younger brother to surgeon Werner Körte (1853–1937) and archaeologist Gustav Körte (1852-1917). In 1896, he married Frieda Gropius, the daughter of the architect Martin Gropius (1824–1880).
